summary:
Iteration 18 — banned-term scan + copy-cleanup verification across the 12 public routes, all 6 service popups, /services SEO sections, /contact + /ai-assessment + /roi-calculator + /smart-calendar E2E, and backend endpoints. GOOD NEWS: the banned-term audit is clean on 12/12 routes (body innerText, title, meta description, meta keywords, og:title, twitter:title all pass — only 'guarantee' hits found are FAQ questions and negative disclaimers, not positive promises). SEO sections on /services render both new blocks with the required headings and all 12 internal + 12 external links (external links all have target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer). ALL SIX service popups render 'What It Does' / 'Why Choose Us' / 'What You Get' / 'Discuss this with us' with the two new CTA testids (service-popup-proposal-btn-<id> = 'Request a Scoped Proposal', service-popup-book-btn-<id> = 'Book a Discovery Call'); Escape closes each popup; healthcare popup renders 8 not-included items and 6 who-we-serve items. AI Assessment (/ai-assessment) E2E clean: H1 = 'Execution Readiness Assessment', 5 questions are the new delivery-visibility phrasing (no 'AI adoption' language), result view shows 'Your Execution Readiness Report' + score badge + 'Readiness Level: Reactive Execution' (allowed label set) + 'Suggested Priorities', recommendations contain none of the banned AI-training phrases. ROI Calculator (/roi-calculator) E2E clean: 'Your Modelled Scenario' header, disclaimer with 'planning scenario' + 'not a forecast, a promise, or a guarantee of results', metric cards 'Modelled Return' / 'Modelled Annual Effect' / 'Indicative Payback' / 'Indicative Investment', 'Modelled Effects' block, 'Services That Fit This Scenario', 'Book a Discovery Call' CTA. Empty-services fallback correctly returns 'Project Management as a Service (PMaaS)' + 'Delivery and Operational Governance' (no 'AI Project Management' / 'Digital Transformation'). Backend confirms same for POST /api/roi-calculator. Contact page perfectly clean: 4 cards with new copy, subject placeholder = 'Delivery visibility, project governance, or ORQYNE enquiry', message placeholder rewritten around execution problem, form submits, contact-success-message renders 'within one business day' with 'honest read on fit'. All 12 SPA titles remain unique after this round. No console errors. No mobile overflow on /services at 390x844. Footer 'Execution Readiness Assessment' link -> /ai-assessment works. Backend endpoints: /api/health 200, /api/contact 200, /api/ai-assessment 200 (returns score_label from {Reactive/Developing/Structured/Governed} Execution set — new labels active), /api/roi-calculator 200 with new fallback services list, /api/newsletter 200, /api/admin-login 200, GET /api/admin 200 with bearer.

HOWEVER, the copy cleanup on Smart Calendar / Contact toast / consultation next_steps is INCOMPLETE. Four separate 'within 24 hours' occurrences remain, plus the Smart Calendar form-side H1 and subtitle still use the old AI-transformation positioning that this whole ticket was meant to remove. See action_items — these are the last mile of the same cleanup and are user-facing.

minor.issue: Response 200 body has an internal inconsistency: 'message' correctly says 'within one business day' but 'next_steps[1]' still hard-codes 'Our team will contact you within 24 hours' (api/_handlers/consultation.js line 189). Same file line 165 also still uses '24 hours' in the duplicate-submission error, which the review copy cleanup was meant to remove.

ui_bugs.issue: H1 still reads 'Book Your AI Consultation' and subtitle still reads 'Schedule a free 30-minute consultation with our AI transformation experts.' — this is the exact positioning the copy cleanup was supposed to remove (frontend/src/pages/SmartCalendar.js lines 141 and 144). Also line 147 label reads 'Prefer to pick a slot yourself?' whereas the confirmation-view heading (line 112) reads 'Prefer to pick a time yourself?' — inconsistent wording between the two states, and the review spec expects the 'time yourself' wording.
Consultation Details subtitle still hard-codes 'Fill in your details and we'll confirm your slot within 24 hours.' (SmartCalendar.js line 163). Must be 'within one business day' per the copy cleanup.

Confirmation H1 says 'Consultation Request Received!' and subtitle says 'Our team will contact you within 24 hours to confirm.' (SmartCalendar.js lines 77 & 80). Should read 'within one business day' — this is the exact spec item flagged for /smart-calendar. Note the review's other three copy asks on this page (Prefer to pick a time yourself? / the three PerkRow labels) are already correct.

The sonner toast on successful contact submit still says 'Message sent! We'll respond within 24 hours.' (frontend/src/pages/Contact.js line 77). The in-page contact-success-message correctly says 'within one business day', but the toast is stale. User-visible inconsistency between two responses to the same action.

action_items: SmartCalendar.js: replace 'Book Your AI Consultation' (line 141) and 'AI transformation experts' subtitle (line 144) with the new discovery-call / delivery-execution positioning that matches Home and Products.
SmartCalendar.js: change form-view subtitle (line 163) 'we'll confirm your slot within 24 hours' -> 'within one business day'.

SmartCalendar.js: change confirmation-view H1 (line 77) 'Consultation Request Received!' + subtitle (line 80) 'Our team will contact you within 24 hours to confirm.' to the new discovery-call copy with 'within one business day'.

SmartCalendar.js: align labels (line 147 uses 'Prefer to pick a slot yourself?', line 112 uses 'Prefer to pick a time yourself?'). Standardise on the review spec wording 'Prefer to pick a time yourself?'.
Contact.js: change toast (line 77) from "Message sent! We'll respond within 24 hours." to "Message sent! We'll respond within one business day." so it matches the contact-success-message copy.

api/_handlers/consultation.js: fix next_steps[1] on the /api/consultation 200 response (line 189) from 'Our team will contact you within 24 hours' to 'Our team will contact you within one business day'. Also update the duplicate-request error message at line 165 ('...in the last 24 hours...') for the same reason; keep the 24h duplicate-window logic if that is intentional, but reword the user-facing text.
Restart Node sidecar after api/_handlers/consultation.js edit (does not hot reload).
critical_code_review_comments: The 'within 24 hours' cleanup is only ~80% done: it was updated in the Contact page card + success message + assessment / ROI copy, but four occurrences slipped through (2x SmartCalendar.js, 1x Contact.js toast, 2x consultation.js handler). A repo-wide grep for '24 hours' should be a mandatory acceptance gate for this ticket.

SmartCalendar.js form view still carries the pre-cleanup 'AI Consultation / AI transformation experts' hero copy. Because the confirmation view was updated but the form view was not, the same page now has two different voices depending on state — this is exactly the inconsistency the ticket set out to fix.

consultation.js currently produces a self-contradictory JSON body (message says 'one business day', next_steps says '24 hours'). This is a user-facing regression — any client rendering next_steps will show conflicting timelines.

The 'Prefer to pick a slot yourself?' vs 'Prefer to pick a time yourself?' mismatch on SmartCalendar.js (lines 147 vs 112) suggests only the confirmation-view path of the file was reviewed during the copy pass.

success_rate.backend: 6/7 (86%) — only consultation copy-consistency assertion fails; the endpoint itself is 200 and functional
success_rate.frontend: banned-term scan 12/12 clean; SEO sections + all 6 service popups + AI Assessment E2E + ROI E2E + Contact E2E all pass. SmartCalendar E2E fails on 3 copy points listed above.

seed_data_creation: Backend test suite inserts TEST_-prefixed leads on each run (contact, ai_assessment, roi_calculator, newsletter). Frontend E2E added: AI assessment 'testexec18@example.com' (score 10, Reactive Execution), ROI 'test_roi18@example.com' (TEST_ROICo_18), contact 'test_contact_<ts>@example.com'. All safe to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Banned-term scan across all 12 routes is fully green (see BANNED constant in iteration 18 for the exact list). SEO sections and 6 service popups on /services are done — the 4 remaining copy items are all localised to two files: frontend/src/pages/SmartCalendar.js and frontend/src/pages/Contact.js plus one handler api/_handlers/consultation.js (next_steps[1] and duplicate-window message). Once those three files are updated and the node sidecar restarted, re-run: (a) grep -rn '24 hours' /app/frontend/src /app/api should return 0 human-facing hits; (b) POST /api/consultation and assert '24 hours' NOT in response body; (c) revisit /smart-calendar and verify both form and confirmation views. Everything else in this ticket is already verified passing and does not need to be re-tested.
